Output: Output 1 Indicator: Capacity of executing agencies and implementing unit for project management improved. Progress/Status: The PIU was established in December 2021 with complete staffing by March 2022. The PIU has supported DOWH in the selection process of the consulting firms. The DOWH, PIU, and ADB have been having regular meetings since April 2021 to monitor the status of the progress and agree on the next actions. The PIU has initially followed direct payment procedures to process the PIU staff claims. These procedures are being used also to process the firms claims. The PIU has supported DOWH in the activation and utilization of advance account and trust account per PAM.
During project team's review mission in March 2023, it was noted that the provincial DOWH offices in Vanimo and Wewak are understaffed which may compromise the Northern region road corridor project (Momase international highway) from Wutung to Wewak, including Vanimo and Wewak ports preparation and implementation considering the extensive scope of the project. Assuming that it is challenging to recruit senior staff, DOWH should start identifying suitable junior staff and recruit young experts to be trained, with ADB support, during the project preparation.
As of end Q1 2025, PIU has one international highway design engineer, one international procurement specialist, one international financial management specialist, one national project manager, one national deputy project manager, and one national project accountant. The recruitment activities for one national social safeguards expert and one national gender specialist are ongoing.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Feasibility study, including option analysis, environmental and social safeguard studies, detailed engineering design, bidding documents, and advance procurement actions for ensuing projects completed. Progress/Status: As of Q1 2025: (i) Progress Reports No. 5 and 6 (out of 10 reports) for Momase international highway have been submitted by the consultant and are under review by DOWH and ADB; (ii) Progress Report No. 2 (out of 10 reports) for MRIRP2 - Core Road Network has been submitted, reviewed, and for approval; and (iii) Progress Reports No. 4a and 4b (out of 10 reports) for MRIRP - Bulolo Junction are under preparation. Surveys and investigation activities are ongoing for all assignments. The consulting firm engaged to design the two bridges of SHRCRNP is having discussions with DOWH on contract extension and revised work program.
